ID: `jado-craft-core`.

## What it does

Reads the expected outcome, design direction, tokens and components before editing. Requires readable hierarchy and realistic content, then checks contrast, accessible names, focus and keyboard interaction where relevant. On new or redesigned surfaces, removes small headings above the title that are purely decorative, preserving breadcrumbs, states and informative labels.

## When to use it

Use it when creating or changing a UI, including a quick patch. The check remains within the assigned scope. If Impeccable is selected, this baseline does not replace its prerequisites and steps.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-craft-core` in Claude Code or `$jado-craft-core` in Codex. Provide the brief, reference and project components. Apply checks to the actual result with representative content. Report what was verified and pass any out-of-scope design questions to the coordinator.

## What it delivers

- UI consistent with the reference and scope
- Relevant quality checks applied
- Defects or limitations to carry into the handoff

## Example

Apply jado-craft-core to the project card: preserve tokens and components, use realistic content and check hierarchy, focus and button names.
